description_en: Stops a running Cloud Assistant command process on one or more ECS instances
description_zh: 调用StopInvocation停止一台或多台ECS实例中一条正在进行中（Running）的云助手命令进程
kebab_example: aliyun ecs stop-invocation --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --invoke-id t-7d2a745b412b4601b2d47f6a768d0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopInvocation

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The command execution ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/64840.html to query all execution IDs
parameters.help_zh: 命令执行ID。您可以通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/64840.html查询所有的InvokeId。
parameters.name: invoke_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of instances on which you want to stop the command. You can specify up to 50 instance IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 要停止执行命令的实例列表，最多能指定50台实例ID。N的取值范围为1~50
parameters.name: instance_id
